csv_agency: State of Rhode Island Dept of Administration
csv_scope_of_work: On-Call Design Consultant Services Program 1 is seeking firms with adequate size, sufficient staff, and experience to perform a variety of RIDOT Work Order assignments with varying complexities relating to all disciplines of bridge, facilities, highway, safety, site, and stormwater engineering. Services under this selection shall be coordinated and managed under the direction of RIDOT's Office of Project Management. As directed by RIDOT, the Consultant shall be responsible for conducting the necessary surveys, inspections, borings, permitting, analysis, design, investigations, review of pertinent existing reports, and any other tasks necessary to adequately detail the work necessary. The Prime Consultant shall disclose whether they will self-perform or acquire the services of a SubConsultant/Contractor to perform the services listed below. If not self-performing, provide the qualifications and resumes for each Sub-Consultant. a. Engineering b. Geotechnical Services c. Contract TimeDetermination d. Subsurface Investigation Services (i.e., Test Pits and SoilBorings) e. Survey f. Historical/Cultural Resources (i.e., Section 4 (f), Section 6 (f), Section106) g. Environmental (i.e., Stormwater, Permitting, Hydraulic Studies and Reports, Hazmat, Soil Management, SWPPP, landscaping, etc.) h. Electrical (i.e., lighting,etc.) i. Maintenance & Protection of TrafficControl j. Traffic DataCollection k. Materials Testing (i.e., GPR, concrete cores,etc.) l. Utility Locating m. Landscape Architecture n. Architectural o. Interior Design p. HVAC/Mechanical q. Electrical r. Plumbing s. IT/Telecommunications t. Fire Protection u. Structural Design v. Value Engineering

title: On-Call Design Consultant Services Program 1
short_description: On-call multidisciplinary design services for RIDOT bridge, highway, facilities, and site assignments.
project_scope: Framework-style on-call consultant services for varying RIDOT work order assignments of differing complexity across bridge, facilities, highway, safety, site, and stormwater engineering. The consultant may be tasked with surveys, inspections, borings, permitting, analysis, design, investigations, review of existing reports, and related support services. No specific structure, span, floor area, or individual project technical parameters are defined in the notice.
services: Multidisciplinary on-call design consulting including engineering, geotechnical services, contract time determination, subsurface investigations, surveying, historical/cultural resources, environmental services, electrical, maintenance and protection of traffic control, traffic data collection, materials testing, utility locating, landscape architecture, architectural, interior design, HVAC/mechanical, electrical, plumbing, IT/telecommunications, fire protection, structural design, and value engineering.
relevance_explanation:
- This is an on-call multidisciplinary framework-type consultant program rather than a defined structural project.
- The notice includes bridge and structural design, which is generally relevant to sbp.
- However, no specific bridge, span, special structure, or architecturally demanding scope is identified.
- The scope is heavily broad and includes many non-core disciplines such as MEP, interiors, traffic, environmental, and surveying.
- Framework agreements without clear technical specification are explicitly low priority for sbp, especially when no distinct structural opportunity is described.
construction_cost_explanation: No construction cost for any specific project is stated. The notice gives a contract value of 5000000, but this appears to be the consultant services contract ceiling, not construction cost. Because the procurement is an on-call program covering multiple future assignments with undefined scope, a realistic construction cost estimate is not possible from the provided information.
fee_explanation: No explicit fee for sbp-relevant structural services is stated. The only stated amount is the overall consultant contract value of 5000000 for the on-call program, covering many disciplines and future task orders; therefore no reliable sbp fee can be derived.
references_qualifications: Firms must demonstrate adequate size, sufficient staff, and experience to perform RIDOT work order assignments of varying complexity. The prime consultant must disclose whether services will be self-performed or subcontracted; if subcontracted, qualifications and resumes for each subconsultant must be provided.
